text: janeti purisaṃ kiṃsu tassa vidhāvati kiṃsu saṃsāramāpādi kismā na parimuccatīti . [169] taṇhā janeti purisaṃ cittamassa vidhāvati satto saṃsāramāpādi dukkhā na parimuccatīti . sattamaṃ tatiyajanasuttaṃ [170] kiṃsu janeti purisaṃ kiṃsu tassa vidhāvati kiṃsu saṃsāramāpādi kiṃsu tassa parāyananti .
